description: Run JavaScript in the page's own context (page globals are visible) and return the result of the last expression, awaited if it is a promise. Works on sites with a strict CSP. Use for reading data the outline does not show or driving page APIs directly.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

name: run_js
title: Run JavaScript in the page
